summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a corporate restructuring: it will split certain core business components (design, branding, sales) from subsidiary VinFast Trading and Production JSC (VFTP) into a new controlled entity, then sell all its interest in VFTP (manufacturing assets and liabilities) to a buyer group led by Future Investment Research and Development Joint Stock Company via a share purchase agreement dated May 12, 2026. No price per share, premium, or enterprise value is stated. The board resolved to hold an EGM on May 27, 2026 for shareholder approval. The transaction aims to transition to an asset-light model, reducing capital expenditures. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and regulatory clearances in Vietnam; risk-arb centers on execution of the separation and buyer financing.
